effects.printed_clause: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target up to 5 "Scarstech" cards in your GY or banishment; shuffle them into the Deck, then draw 1 card.

Resolution filters still-related targets, shuffles them into Deck/Extra Deck, and draws one if at least one operated card reaches those destinations.

official_references.matched_structure: Official effect targets/selects a bounded GY group, shuffles surviving cards into the Deck, checks successful return, then draws.

coverage_override.reason: The hand self-Summon, Summon-triggered Deck send, and Chain-Link-based team boost are three effects; Normal/Special trigger clones do not double-count the second printed effect, and the HOPT sentence is shared.

effects.printed_clause: When a card or effect is activated as Chain Link 2 or higher (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: A hand EVENT_CHAINING Quick Effect with id HOPT checks Duel.GetCurrentChain()>=2, zone capacity, and summon legality, then Special Summons the related handler.

official_references.matched_structure: Official chain-sensitive effect recognizes Chain Link 2 or higher with EVENT_CHAINING and Duel.GetCurrentChain()>1.
Official hand trigger checks capacity and Special Summons its handler in response to the qualifying event.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 "Scarstech" monster from your Deck to the GY.
effects.lua_implementation: Delayed optional EVENT_SUMMON_SUCCESS and EVENT_SPSUMMON_SUCCESS clones share id+100, require an able-to-GY Scarstech monster in Deck, and send one selected card with REASON_EFFECT.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Deck-send effect filters an able-to-GY monster, selects exactly one from LOCATION_DECK, and sends it with REASON_EFFECT.

effects.printed_clause: When a card or effect is activated as Chain Link 2 or higher (Quick Effect): You can make all "Scarstech" monsters you currently control gain 100 ATK/DEF times the Chain Link number of this effect.
effects.lua_implementation: An MZONE EVENT_CHAINING Quick Effect with id+200 checks current chain at least 2, requires a face-up controlled Scarstech monster, snapshots Duel.GetCurrentChain()*100 during targeting as this effect's Chain Link value, then gives every currently controlled face-up Scarstech monster standard-reset ATK and DEF updates of that value. With no printed duration, the boosts persist while each affected card remains face-up.

official_references.matched_structure: Official EVENT_CHAINING effect reads Duel.GetCurrentChain() to apply a benefit when the chain reaches Link 2 or higher.

coverage_override.reason: Send-self cost, temporary control, and type changes are one Chain-Link-3 Quick Effect; the two alternative activation conditions belong to one GY self-Summon effect. The final HOPT sentence covers those two registrations.

effects.printed_clause: When a card or effect is activated as Chain Link 3 or higher (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand or field to the GY; take control of 1 monster your opponent controls until the End Phase, also it becomes a DARK Galaxy monster.
effects.lua_implementation: An EVENT_CHAINING Quick Effect with id HOPT currently has range LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_MZONE, requires current chain at least 3, and sends itself to the GY as cost. At resolution it non-target-selects one opponent monster whose control can change, takes it through the End Phase, and applies standard/End-Phase-reset DARK attribute and Galaxy race changes.

official_references.matched_structure: Official EVENT_CHAINING Quick Effect checks Duel.GetCurrentChain()>2 for a Chain-Link-3-or-higher response.
Official effect takes control of one opponent monster only until the End Phase using Duel.GetControl.

effects.issue: The cost expressly allows sending this card from the hand or field, but e1 is registered only in LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_MZONE. If Scarstech Invader is a face-up Monster Card in the Spell/Trap Zone, it is on the field yet cannot activate this printed effect. Include the appropriate on-field activation range (at least LOCATION_SZONE in addition to MZONE) and preserve current-type/activation legality.

effects.printed_clause: When a card or effect is activated as Chain Link 5 or higher, or when a "Scarstech" card or effect is activated while this card is in your GY (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card.
effects.lua_implementation: A GY EVENT_CHAINING Quick Effect with id+100 requires the activating handler not be this card and accepts either Duel.GetCurrentChain()>=5 or a handler with the Scarstech set code. Target and operation both check Monster Zone capacity, Necrovalley, relatedness, and Special Summon legality before reviving this card.

official_references.matched_structure: Official chain-sensitive effect uses Duel.GetCurrentChain()>=5 to recognize Chain Link 5 or higher.
Official hand/GY effect checks self-Summon legality and Necrovalley before Special Summoning the handler from the GY.
